randomization.algorithm: For replicate r, sort blind IDs by ascending lowercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 'askrigor-208-complete-blinded-development-ab-v1-replicate-' + r + '|' + blind_id.
randomization.armOrder: A then B when replicate_number + one_based_position is even; otherwise B then A

A.prompt: exact arm-a-prompt.txt plus exact blind ID and source packet

sequence: if schema-invalid or SYNTHESIS_LOCK block/insufficient, send one exact receipt-only repair prompt
freeze repaired state and reverify exactly once
send exact synthesis prompt with final state and receipt
B.stateParsing: hash raw text first; trim BOM/surrounding whitespace; optionally unwrap exactly one complete JSON fence only if nothing else exists; no other repair/extraction
B.schemaFailure: machine STATE_SCHEMA_INVALID receipt with deterministic parse/schema errors and SYNTHESIS_LOCK=block; eligible for the one repair
B.intrinsicBlock: preserve limitation; hypothesis may be abandoned or narrowed; never fabricate a pass
B.finalInvalid: preserve raw state and blocking receipt; request bounded synthesis

mechanicalRecovery.resendOnlyWhen: DOM and history prove no accepted user message and no generation began

transportAndBrowser.unexpectedTab: close; stop if cross-trial or external evidence was exposed
